paper_title: Counterfactual Influence as a Distributional Quantity
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the loss values over epochs for a train and validation set. The x-axis represents epochs, using a linear scale spanning from 0 to 30, with tick labels spaced every 5 epochs. The y-axis represents loss, using a linear scale from approximately 0.20 to 0.95, with tick labels spaced by increments of 0.1. A blue line represents the loss of the train set, starting at approximately 0.45 at epoch 0 and decreasing to approximately 0.30 at epoch 30, exhibiting a general downward trend. A green line represents the loss of the validation set, starting at approximately 0.60 at epoch 0 and decreasing to approximately 0.10 at epoch 30, demonstrating a similar downward trend with a peak around epoch 12 at approximately 0.80.
